body: What are these changes for? They seem unrelated and would be good to document why

Well, previously, some checks failed, I thought it was because of this, but if this is not the case, I can reverse it
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/20224035405
Probably something incorrect with the usage, but that's okay, I think it's because of the order of creation

@AThousandShips 
Here are the errors after reverting the last change
```
ERROR: Class 'EditorExport' already has signal ''.
   at: (core\object\class_db.cpp:1402)
ERROR: Class 'EditorExport' already has signal ''.
   at: (core\object\class_db.cpp:1402)
ERROR: In Object of type 'EditorExport': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'export_presets_runnable_updated' to callable 'EditorExportPlatformAndroid::_update_preset_status'.
   at: (core\object\object.cpp:1606)
ERROR: In Object of type 'EditorExport': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'export_presets_updated' to callable 'ProjectExportDialog::_force_update_current_preset_parameters'.
   at: (core\object\object.cpp:1606)
```
That's because the order of operations, `_bind_methods` is called before the constructor, I'll add a suggestion later today to fix it
Tnx, also look at https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114028#issuecomment-3656621850. I uploaded a few pictures
It's only happened per file change, and not per run, so if I build Godot 2 times, it's only happened the first time

+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
+<class name="EditorExport" inherits="Node" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../class.xsd">
+	<brief_description>
+		Manages export platforms and presets for exporting Godot projects.
+	</brief_description>
+	<description>
+		Singleton class that handles the export system in Godot. It maintains collections of export platforms (like Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, Web) and export presets (configurations for each platform). This class is responsible for loading and saving export configurations, as well as providing access to export functionality through the editor.
+		Export platforms define how projects are exported to specific target platforms, while export presets store the configuration settings for each export target.
+	</description>
+	<tutorials>
+	</tutorials>
+	<methods>
+		<method name="add_export_platform">
+			<return type="void" />
+			<param index="0" name="platform" type="EditorExportPlatform" />
+			<description>
+				Adds an export platform to the available platforms list. The platform is initialized and becomes available for creating export presets.
body:
```suggestion
				Adds an export platform to the available platform list. The platform is initialized and becomes available for creating export presets.
```
No plural here in English, see [here](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/documentation/guidelines/docs_writing_guidelines.html#the-noun-adjunct)

@AThousandShips I'm getting `INTERNAL ERROR: In Object of type 'Object': Attempt to connect nonexistent signal 'export_presets_runnable_updated' to callable 'EditorExportPlatformAndroid::_update_preset_status'.`

That's because of the broader order issue of binding it like this, not sure how to solve that unfortunately 

The problem is that it's used before it's bound correctly

Is it okay to do something like this?
```c++
callable_mp(EditorExport::get_singleton(), &EditorExport::connect_presets_runnable_updated).call_deferred(callable_mp(this, &EditorExportPlatformAndroid::_update_preset_status));
```
I tested it, seem fixes the problem
